questions.question: In Berkeley Lab's queue data, of the capacity that entered ERCOT's interconnection queue in 2019, how many MW are now operating?
questions.answer: In Berkeley Lab's Queued Up 2026 edition (requests through 2025), 9,451.88 MW of the capacity that entered ERCOT's queue in 2019 now has status "operational" (lbnl_interconnection_queue, sum of capacity_mw over 64 queue positions). That is out of 43,557.71 MW across all 245 ERCOT positions with a 2019 queue year (same table). "Entered in 2019" is read as the table's q_year of 2019. This is a source table, queried on the live set (snapshot dated 2026-10-02).
